The '''Stone Cities of Bogan''' was a large settlement created by the [[Tythan]]s on the moon of [[Bogan]]. These were made when the non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans were compelled to leave their homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. From the moon, the Tythonians later departed further into the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] to create the [[Settled Worlds]] and left behind only the Stone Cities on Bogan.

In the aftermath of their departure, the [[Je'daii Order]] began exiling those [[Je'daii]] that became imbalanced in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to Bogan. Once exiled, these Je'daii used the empty Stone Cities as their refuge whilst they contemplated [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and sought balance in it. Following [[Tau (individual)|Xesh's]] arrival to Tython, the Je'daii Order decided to banish him to Bogan where he remained at the Stone Cities until Xesh met fellow exile [[Daegen Lok]].
